points.label: Incomplete Task Execution
points.description: Agent claims completion while key subtasks remain undone.

points.label: Fabricated References
points.description: Agent emits code referencing non-existent functions or packages.

points.label: Stale API Usage
points.description: Agent uses deprecated or removed APIs.

points.label: Cascading Error Recovery
points.description: Agent's fix attempts introduce new errors that compound.

points.label: Context Window Overflow
points.description: Important context is truncated; agent drifts.

points.label: Tool Misinvocation
points.description: Correct tool, wrong arguments or wrong sequence.

points.label: Silent Test-Passing Workaround
points.description: Agent modifies tests or test harness to mask failure.

points.label: Destructive Action
points.description: Agent executes rm/force-push/commit bypass without human approval.

points.label: Goal Drift
points.description: Agent's working goal diverges from the user's stated goal.

points.label: Role Violation
points.description: Agent acts outside its declared role or scope.

points.label: Task Decomposition Failure
points.description: Agent fails to break a task into solvable subtasks.

points.label: Coordination Failure
points.description: Agents fail to coordinate on shared state or handoff.

points.label: Redundant Work
points.description: Multiple agents duplicate effort without coordination.

points.label: Communication Breakdown
points.description: Messages between agents are lost, misinterpreted, or ignored.

points.label: Stalling / Deadlock
points.description: Agents block waiting on each other with no progress.

points.label: Premature Termination
points.description: Agent ends a task before completion criteria are met.

points.label: Goal Drift
points.description: Agent's working goal diverges from the user's stated goal.

points.label: Tool Misuse
points.description: Agent invokes an available tool incorrectly or unnecessarily.

points.label: Fabrication in Inter-Agent Messages
points.description: Agent sends factually incorrect information to another agent.

points.label: Verification Failure
points.description: Agent accepts incorrect output without checking.

points.label: Escalation Failure
points.description: Agent does not escalate to a human when appropriate.

points.label: Context Loss
points.description: Relevant prior context is dropped or truncated.

points.label: Infinite Loop
points.description: Agent cycles over the same state or tool call indefinitely.

points.label: Agent Compromise
points.description: Unauthorized control or manipulation of an agent; one corrupted node can subvert entire multi-agent workflows.

points.label: Agent Injection
points.description: Insertion of malicious instructions into agent prompts, plans, or tool-call arguments.

points.label: Agent Impersonation
points.description: Threat actors register counterfeit agents that appear legitimate, tricking other modules into leaking data or executing actions.

points.label: Agent Flow Manipulation
points.description: Unauthorized alteration of agent workflow execution paths, e.g., injecting tokens like STOP to reroute workflows or bypass safety logic.

points.label: Multi-Agent Jailbreaks
points.description: Jailbreak payload split across agent messages; recombination bypasses single-prompt detectors. Specific to multi-agent topologies.

points.label: Intra-Agent Responsible AI Concerns
points.description: Toxic or RAI-violating content propagates through internal inter-agent messages and reaches users or logs without filtering.

points.label: Bias in Resource Allocation
points.description: Discriminatory distribution of resources across users when agents act as allocators.

points.label: Organizational Knowledge Degradation
points.description: Heavy automation erodes human understanding of the underlying system; recovery is difficult when agents fail.

points.label: Prioritization Risks (Performance Over Safety)
points.description: Goal-driven agents skip safety checks to optimize KPIs, prioritizing performance metrics over user safety.

points.label: Memory Poisoning
points.description: Attackers embed malicious instructions into long-term memory; every future recall re-executes the attack. Flagship case study in the paper.

points.label: Cross-Domain Prompt Injection (XPIA)
points.description: External content (PDFs, calendar invites, web pages) contains hidden commands that hijack agent decision logic.

points.label: Human-in-the-Loop Bypass
points.description: Circumvention of human oversight and approval gates.

points.label: Incorrect Permissions Management
points.description: Over-scoped agent permissions let agents access files or perform actions beyond the user's intent.

points.label: Insufficient Isolation
points.description: Inadequate separation between agent operational boundaries, enabling lateral compromise.

points.label: Bias Amplification
points.description: Magnification of existing prejudices in agent outputs across iterative loops.

points.label: Hallucinations
points.description: Generation of false or fabricated information, including fabricated tool calls and references.

points.label: Misinterpretation of Instructions
points.description: Incorrect understanding of user directives leading to unintended actions.

points.label: Lack of Transparency
points.description: Insufficient clarity over agent behavior, preventing informed user consent and oversight.

points.label: Agent Goal Hijack
points.description: Attacker-induced diversion of an agent from its user-assigned goal.

points.label: Tool Misuse and Exploitation
points.description: Abuse of the agent's tool surface to exceed intended authority.

points.label: Identity and Privilege Abuse
points.description: Misuse of agent identities or escalation of privileges.

points.label: Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
points.description: Compromise via the agent's software, tool, model, or data supply chain, including hallucinated-package-name typosquatting (slopsquatting).

points.label: Unexpected Code Execution (RCE)
points.description: Agent emits or runs code producing unintended remote execution.

points.label: Memory & Context Poisoning
points.description: Attacker manipulation of agent memory or long-context state.

points.label: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
points.description: Weakly authenticated or validated messages between agents.

points.label: Cascading Failures
points.description: Errors that propagate across agent subsystems or the agent fleet.

points.label: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
points.description: Social-engineering of humans by or via an agent.

points.label: Rogue Agents
points.description: Unsanctioned or self-modifying agents operating outside policy.

points.label: Agent Cognition and Orchestration
points.description: Failures in cognitive architecture and control flows unique to agentic systems (83 faults in the sample). Covers LLM integration and agent lifecycle/state.

points.label: Tooling, Integration, and Actuation
points.description: Defects in tool invocation and external-system interaction (66 faults). Covers API usage, external connectivity, resource manipulation, coordination, and observability of tool calls.

points.label: Perception, Context, and Memory
points.description: Faults in information ingestion, context preservation, and input interpretation (72 faults). Covers persistence and input-interpretation logic.

points.label: Runtime and Environment Grounding
points.description: Execution environment, dependency stack, and platform-constraint mismatches (87 faults). The single largest fault dimension by count, dominated by dependency management.

points.label: System Reliability and Observability
points.description: Robustness deficiencies and diagnostic challenges in autonomous systems (67 faults). Covers error recovery, UI/visualization, and documentation.

points.label: LLM Integration Faults
points.description: Faults in how the agent integrates with its LLM (45 faults).

points.label: Agent Lifecycle and State
points.description: Faults in agent startup, execution, termination, and state tracking (38 faults).

points.label: Tool Execution and API Usage
points.description: Incorrect or malformed tool/API invocations (17 faults).

points.label: External Connectivity and Access
points.description: Connection setup and authentication failures (19 faults).

points.label: Resource Manipulation
points.description: Resource-handling and database-misconfiguration faults (16 faults).

points.label: System Coordination
points.description: Synchronization errors across components or agents (6 faults).

points.label: System Observability
points.description: Logging or telemetry defects (8 faults).

points.label: Context and State Persistence
points.description: Memory-persistence and state-load/save failures (12 faults).

points.label: Input Interpretation and Logic
points.description: Type handling, validation, encoding, and logic/constraint violations (60 faults).

points.label: Dependency Management
points.description: Dependency specification, import resolution, installation, and package resolver/manager failures (67 faults). The single largest major category.

points.label: Platform Compatibility
points.description: Environment, platform, API, and integration compatibility mismatches (20 faults).

points.label: Robustness and Error Recovery
points.description: Exception-handling and implementation defects (49 faults).

points.label: UI, Visualization, and Documentation Defects
points.description: UI defects (13 faults) and documentation defects (5 faults).

points.label: Dependency and Integration Failures
points.description: Contract violations between probabilistic artifacts and deterministic interfaces (19.5%).

points.label: Data and Type Handling Failures
points.description: Type mismatches and validation gaps (17.6%).

points.label: Incorrect Token Management
points.description: Tracking and counting errors affecting context windows.

points.label: Authentication and Credential Issues
points.description: Fragile token refresh and credential-expiration handling.

points.label: Datetime Conversion Errors
points.description: Inappropriate temporal-value transformations.

points.label: State Management Defects
points.description: Inconsistent internal state across interactions.

points.label: Configuration Inconsistencies
points.description: Wrong defaults and misconfiguration.

points.label: API Evolution and Schema Drift
points.description: Incompatibilities from upstream API changes.

points.label: Environment-Level Issues
points.description: Platform-specific constraints and virtual-environment problems.

points.label: Documentation Gaps
points.description: Missing or incorrect configuration guidance.

points.label: Exception Suppression
points.description: Swallowed errors reducing observability.

points.label: Ecosystem Fragility
points.description: Rapid upstream evolution creating tight-coupling vulnerabilities.

points.label: Accuracy
points.description: Mitigates hallucinations, misinformation, and disinformation to ensure factually correct outputs.

points.label: Efficiency
points.description: Prevents resource-intensive tasks and endless loops; manages cost through dynamic resource management.

points.label: Privacy
points.description: Protects against sensitive-data leakage via direct responses or statistical inference.

points.label: Security
points.description: Defends against malicious activities and adversarial attacks; preserves data confidentiality and integrity.

points.label: Safety
points.description: Prevents harmful or misleading outputs, especially in high-stakes domains.

points.label: Fairness
points.description: Addresses bias and discrimination from training data, algorithms, or deployment.

points.label: Compliance
points.description: Ensures adherence to legal, regulatory, and industry standards via continuous monitoring.

points.label: Generalizability
points.description: Functions effectively across multiple layers and diverse scenarios without per-case configuration.

points.label: Customizability
points.description: Tailored protection for specific requirements at different operational layers.

points.label: Adaptability
points.description: Adjusts dynamically to varying conditions and emerging threats without manual reconfiguration.

points.label: Traceability
points.description: Detailed logs of decision paths, inputs, outputs, and data sources for auditing.

points.label: Portability
points.description: Guardrail transfers across FM-based agents with minimal adjustment.

points.label: Interoperability
points.description: Functions seamlessly across heterogeneous agents, technologies, and interfaces.

points.label: Interpretability
points.description: Provides clarity on how a guardrail operates, enabling user understanding and trust.

points.label: Prompt Stage
points.description: Incoming user queries analyzed for harmful content and safety alignment before processing.

points.label: Intermediate Results Stage
points.description: Outputs at workflow stages verified for accuracy and safety before final generation.

points.label: Final Results Stage
points.description: Final agent outputs checked for goal alignment and governance compliance.

points.label: Goals
points.description: Declared user or task objectives.

points.label: Context
points.description: Conversation and session context.

points.label: Memory
points.description: Long-term or episodic agent memory.

points.label: Reasoning
points.description: Chain-of-thought and intermediate reasoning traces.

points.label: Plans
points.description: Multi-step action plans produced by the agent.

points.label: Workflows
points.description: End-to-end orchestrated task flows.

points.label: Tools
points.description: External callable tools and APIs.

points.label: Knowledge Bases
points.description: Retrieval corpora and structured knowledge stores.

points.label: Other Agents
points.description: Peer or subordinate agents in a multi-agent system.

points.label: Foundation Models
points.description: The underlying LLM / FM itself.

points.label: Block
points.description: Prevent the action from executing.

points.label: Filter
points.description: Strip disallowed content before forwarding.

points.label: Flag
points.description: Emit a warning for downstream review.

points.label: Modify
points.description: Transform the action or output to a safer variant.

points.label: Validate
points.description: Check against a spec or schema before proceeding.

points.label: Parallel Calls
points.description: Run multiple checkers concurrently for consensus.

points.label: Retry
points.description: Regenerate with adjusted parameters.

points.label: Fall Back
points.description: Switch to a safer alternative pathway.

points.label: Human Intervention
points.description: Escalate to a human-in-the-loop.

points.label: Defer
points.description: Delay the action until conditions are met.

points.label: Isolate
points.description: Run the action in a sandbox or quarantined environment.

points.label: Redundancy
points.description: Duplicate critical checks for defense in depth.

points.label: Evaluate
points.description: Score against metrics before acting.
